bio: Within the luxurious adults-only Hotel Monte Mulini, whether on the sunny terrace or in the intimate dining room of Riva Lounge, a locally inspired cuisine awaits, with specialities such as pljukanci pasta and truffle alongside seafood dishes. Considerable attention is also given to food and wine pairing, with an extensive selection of local labels and sparkling wines, complemented by a carefully curated Champagne offering.
